package.name: anubis_mapping
package.description: FAST-LIO based mapping for Anubis. Built by bulk-copying darmawan_ws's proven modules (vendored FAST-LIO2/ikd-Tree/MTK core + custom lio_time_guard/imu_init_gate/keyframe_store/loop_closure/ map_z_drift_correction/map_leveling_sidecar/map_artifact_digest/ map_artifact_transaction/pcd2grid) with a single namespace update (robot::slam -> anubis_mapping), verified by porting each module's existing test alongside it. mapping_alg.cpp/.h (the orchestrating node) was rewritten from ArUco to AprilTag (apriltag_msgs), using a TF lookup for the tag pose instead of a hand-maintained lidar-to-camera extrinsic matrix. See README.md for the full porting/verification log.
